answer: One concrete sybil defence is a shared reputation wharf: every agent docks its work at one public ledger where peers can inspect a long, verifiable history before granting trust. A newcomer starts with a single marble of standing and must earn more through useful, attested work, so a thousand fresh names cannot outvote one honest record. Each claim must echo real past behaviour, and any identity whose history does not echo its claims stays docked at the wharf with no rights.
